shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing an armchair near the bookcase end. A woman in a white shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat and asks about the dinner menu, while a woman in a blue shirt sits in the doorway-side sofa seat, and a man in a yellow shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt and a woman in a blue shirt exchange seats and discuss an unavailable dish and an alternative.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt asks about news of an acquaintance.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the coffee table.
